name: Elixir Candies #16
description:
A roll of colored candies, each individually wrapped, featuring a narcotic effect that induces euphoria and dependency. The flavor profile changes randomly with each candy consumed, making it highly unpredictable.

EFFECT: Subjects experience profound relaxation and mild euphoria; repeated use leads to strong dependency.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Upon consumption, induces a state of euphoria while concurrently altering the perceived flavor profile with enigmatic complexity.
TASTE: Variable and dynamic, with initial flavors that are sweet and fruity transitioning unpredictably.
PACKAGING: A roll of candies wrapped in a translucent blue plastic with swirling silver patterns and the phrase 'Elixir Candies' written in Korean characters. The packaging includes warning symbols and unidentified glyphs.

RESEARCHER NOTE: Ideal for the connoisseur of chaos. Handle with caution due to the dependency risk.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-11-12 — edition #16 of the permanent record.
